description: Experience the irresistible combination of sweet and savory with this viral Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread. Soft, fluffy bread is generously filled with a creamy, slightly sweet cream cheese mixture and then drenched in a rich, garlicky butter sauce. It's a truly addictive treat perfect for any time of day, embodying the best of Korean street food flavors.

ingredients.item: Round bread rolls (brioche or milk bread)

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160C (325F). Using a sharp knife, cut each bread roll into 6 or 8 wedges, making sure not to cut all the way through the bottom. The cuts should allow the bread to open up like a flower.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, egg yolk, and heavy cream. Whisk until the mixture is smooth and creamy with no lumps. Transfer this filling into a piping bag for easier application.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully open the cuts in each bread roll and pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling generously into each crevice. Ensure the filling is evenly distributed throughout the bread.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Sauce
instructions.text: In another bowl, combine the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, honey, mayonnaise, beaten egg, and milk. Whisk everything together until well combined and smooth. This is your savory and slightly sweet garlic butter dipping sauce.

instructions.title: Dip and Coat the Bread
instructions.text: Take each filled bread roll and thoroughly dip it into the garlic butter sauce, ensuring all sides and crevices are completely coated. Gently squeeze out any excess sauce. Place the coated bread rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is slightly puffed and warm. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning the garlic.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Once baked, remove the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread from the oven. Immediately sprinkle generously with fresh chopped parsley for color and aroma. Serve warm and enjoy this delicious sweet and savory treat!

tips: For the fluffiest bread, use fresh brioche or milk bread rolls. Stale bread will not absorb the sauce as well.
Do not overfill the bread with cream cheese, as it might ooze out too much during baking. A piping bag helps with neatness.
This bread is best enjoyed warm, fresh from the oven. If reheating, warm it gently in an oven or air fryer to maintain crispiness.
article:
Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread: A Sweet and Savory Sensation

In the vibrant world of Korean baking, a truly irresistible creation has emerged, captivating taste buds far and wide: Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread. This isn't your average garlic bread; it's a delightful fusion of sweet, savory, creamy, and garlicky flavors, all wrapped up in a soft, fluffy bun. Originating from the bustling streets and trendy cafes of South Korea, this unique bread has quickly become a global sensation, embodying the innovative spirit of modern Korean cuisine. If you've never experienced the magic of a warm, golden-brown bun oozing with sweetened cream cheese and drenched in a fragrant garlic butter glaze, you're in for an extraordinary treat.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?

At its heart, Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a delightful culinary paradox. Unlike its Italian-American counterpart, which is typically crusty and purely savory, the Korean version offers a complex interplay of textures and tastes. It starts with a soft, often brioche-like or milk bread bun, deeply cut into six wedges but not fully separated. These crevices are then generously piped with a rich, sweetened cream cheese filling. Finally, the entire bun is submerged or thoroughly brushed with a potent, aromatic mixture of melted butter, finely minced garlic, a hint of honey or sugar, and often fresh parsley. The result after baking is a bread that is crispy on the outside, incredibly soft and tender on the inside, with a creamy, tangy-sweet center and a robust, savory-sweet garlic finish. This harmonious blend of flavors and textures defines the unique appeal of Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, making it a beloved snack, breakfast item, or even a dessert.

## Ingredients for Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread

To create the authentic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread experience, selecting the right ingredients is key. Here's what you'll need:

For the Bread:
*   6-8 round, soft buns (brioche buns, milk bread buns, or even dinner rolls work best)

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
*   200g (7 oz) cream cheese, softened
*   30-50g (2-3 tbsp) granulated sugar (adjust to your sweetness preference)
*   1 tbsp milk or heavy cream (to achieve a pipeable consistency)
*   A pinch of salt (optional, to balance the sweetness)

For the Garlic Butter Glaze:
*   100g (7 tbsp) unsalted butter, melted
*   4-6 cloves garlic, very finely minced
*   1 large egg, whisked (optional, adds shine and helps bind the glaze)
*   2-3 tbsp honey or sugar (adjust to your sweetness preference)
*   1 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped (plus extra for garnish)
*   A pinch of salt

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Baking your own Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a rewarding experience. Follow these steps for a perfect batch:

1.  Prepare the Buns: Using a sharp knife, make six deep cuts into each bun, radiating from the center, creating a floral pattern. Be careful not to cut all the way through the bottom, ensuring the bun remains intact.
2.  Make the Cream Cheese Filling: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, sugar, milk/cream, and a pinch of salt (if using). Beat with a whisk or electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Transfer the filling to a piping bag fitted with a round tip, or a Ziploc bag with a corner snipped off.
3.  Fill the Buns: Carefully pipe the cream cheese filling into each of the six crevices you cut into the buns. Be generous, ensuring each section is well-filled. You can also add a dollop to the very center.
4.  Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze: In another bowl, combine the melted butter, finely minced garlic, whisked egg (if using), honey or sugar, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt. Whisk everything together until well combined.
5.  Glaze the Buns: This is a crucial step for the signature flavor. You can either gently dip each filled bun into the garlic butter glaze, ensuring all sides and crevices are coated, or place the buns on a baking tray and generously brush the glaze over them. Ensure plenty of garlic and butter mixture seeps into the cuts and over the top.
6.  Bake: Preheat your oven to 160-170°C (325-340°F). Place the glazed buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the cream cheese filling is warm, and the garlic butter is fragrant and slightly caramelized. Keep an eye on them to prevent burning.
7.  Serve: Remove from the oven, let cool for a minute or two, then garnish with extra fresh parsley if desired. Serve warm.

## Tips for Perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread

Achieving the perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread requires attention to a few details:

*   Choose the Right Bread: Soft, slightly sweet buns like brioche or milk bread are ideal. They absorb the garlic butter beautifully and provide a delightful contrast to the creamy filling. Stale bread won't work as well.
*   Don't Cut Too Deep: While you want deep cuts for plenty of filling and glaze, cutting all the way through will make the buns fall apart during baking.
*   Soften the Cream Cheese: Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature for a smooth, lump-free filling that's easy to pipe.
*   Finely Mince Garlic: For the best flavor distribution and to avoid large chunks of raw garlic, mince your garlic as finely as possible, or even use a garlic press.
*   Balance the Sweetness: The beauty of this bread lies in its sweet and savory balance. Taste your cream cheese filling and garlic glaze mixtures and adjust the sugar/honey to your preference.
*   Generous Glazing: Don't be shy with the garlic butter glaze. It's what gives the bread its iconic flavor and moistness. Let it soak in.
*   Serve Warm: While still delicious at room temperature, Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is truly at its best when served warm, right out of the oven.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is incredibly versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways:

*   Breakfast or Brunch: Pair it with a cup of coffee, tea, or a glass of milk for a decadent start to your day.
*   Snack Time: It makes for a satisfying and flavorful snack any time you're craving something unique.
*   Dessert: Its sweet notes make it a surprising yet delightful dessert option, especially after a savory meal.
*   Appetizer: Cut into individual wedges, it can serve as an impressive and conversation-starting appetizer for gatherings.

Whether enjoyed solo or shared, this unique bread promises a memorable culinary experience.

## Variations and Substitutions

While the classic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is fantastic, there's room for customization:

*   Herbs: Experiment with other fresh herbs like chives, basil, or a touch of rosemary in the garlic butter for different aromatic profiles.
*   Spicy Kick: Add a pinch of red pepper flakes to the garlic butter for a subtle heat.
*   Cheese Variations: For an extra rich filling, mix a small amount of mascarpone or ricotta with the cream cheese. A sprinkle of Parmesan cheese on top before baking can also add a savory crust.
*   Sweetness Adjustment: If you prefer it less sweet, reduce the amount of sugar in the cream cheese filling and honey/sugar in the garlic butter glaze. For a sweeter version, increase it.
*   Different Breads: While brioche and milk bread are traditional, you could try using a softened baguette (cut into thick slices), ciabatta, or even regular dinner rolls for a different texture.
*   Vegan Version: Use plant-based cream cheese, vegan butter, and omit the egg from the glaze. Ensure your chosen buns are also vegan.

This beloved Korean baking creation offers endless possibilities for culinary exploration. So why not try your hand at this delightful Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread? Its unique blend of flavors and textures is sure to impress and satisfy.
